learning_outcomes.text: Students express the principles of career planning.
Students use the methods and techniques of career planning and discuss the effects of character traits on career choice.
Students plan career development process and services according to educational rating.
It helps individuals in career planning throughout their lives.

syllabus_topics: Relationship between career planning and vocational counseling
Preparing a resume and types of resumes
Evaluation of the Turkish education system in line with career planning
Applicability of career planning in schools
bibliography: Kuzgun, Y. (2003). Introduction to Career Guidance and Counseling. Ankara: Nobel
Erdoğmuş, N. (2003). Career Development. Ankara, Nobel
Kulaksızoğlu, A. (2005). Adolescence Psychology. İstanbul Remzi.
Kuzgun, Y. (2003). Career Counseling Theories and Applications. Ankara: Nobel.
